notes.title: Playtest signups now open!
notes.content:
Playtest signups are now open for Night Machine! 


Good news everyone, playtests signups are open! 



Click Request Access on the Night Machine Steam page to join the playtest queue. 



We will be accepting requests on a rolling basis, and you'll receive an email from Steam as soon as you've been granted access. 



Once accepted, you'll also be able to invite up to 3 of your friends to join the playtest immediately, so you can compare notes. 



We're looking forward to letting the first group of players try out Night Machine, and hearing what you all have to say! 



In the meantime, you can join our Discord to say hi, ask questions, and chat with the devs about the game. 

Night Machine Discord
